title: Banner of Courage
rules:

If this dealt damage to the nemesis, the friend gains 1 charge.
Use this card only when playing with the Friends and Foes module.

rules:

OR
You may discard a card in hand that costs 2 Æ or more. If you do, the friend gains 2 charges.
